review.evidence: Historical Base block 48592766 review: GLDY proxy 0x632db1aaace73401a5dc8cde6e9062b8ec0fd819 used UUPS implementation 0xd3a66bf0ecbf910afcc91bd2af3e724656448cb5 with zero admin and beacon slots. Legacy EOA 0x889133442bf36e4291c0b2e23b35b260309cb0fe and prior 2-of-3 Safe 0x655f31f9136d54bc319c00dd43009104646b0951 held TREASURY_ROLE at that historical checkpoint; legacy EOA 0x9625c15f7b305680c1690cd41103870e2050028d and 3-of-5 Safe 0x05ed6826524ebe9f3df837b06803ff797f4e2130 held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. These historical EOA/prior-treasury powers are not current: the retained October 1 block 52024954 controls above record the active treasury 0xaab923eefe8f3264d08b4610c6969d6d98104165 and admin Safe, with those legacy role checks false. The source-verified mint and batchMint paths call _getTotalReservesWithSource before _mint, compare the proposed whole Base total supply against reported gold at a 100% minimum backing ratio, and, when the Chainlink feed path is used, require a positive completed round no older than 12 hours. The GLDY Reserves feed 0xf488FA1B4Ac8210bf0b2d212176ca28c48F86708 is issuer-reported, not independent physical-gold verification. A manual fallback exists and cannot independently carry continuous reconciliation under D33: manual data entry is not mechanical derivation. The retained continuous classification is scoped to the previously observed live feed path and its per-mint whole-Base-supply construction, not an assertion that manual fallback establishes continuity; an observation of operative manual fallback requires reclassification to periodic or unknown. Complete enumeration of all physical reserve vaults behind the feed, and the native-versus-representation scope of the newly publicized Solana secondary venues, remain unestablished and are not certified here. ORCHESTRATOR-AUTHORIZED adverse-pin correction — owner review required (C21, 2026-10-20; REV-B3 clarification): supervision changes from attestation-only to unknown because the actual independent assurance scope could not be verified. The issuer names EisnerAmper and announces a March 31 AICPA examination; the browser-recovered Reserve Reports GLDY index links Streamex Examination Report - March-31.pdf, but the report body at https://ir.streamex.com/static-files/17db884d-3dea-427a-b4ee-d7db192f56ba returned HTTP 403 and direct browser PDF navigation did not recover it. The announcement and index do not independently verify the examiner's actual entire-token-liability scope, native-deployment boundary or qualifications. Attestation-only requires a named independent party's actual reporting scope to cover the issuer's whole token liabilities; unknown records this unresolved scope, not absence of an examiner or an adverse examination. This withdrawal does not impose a minimum number of consecutive reports. Restore attestation-only when the report's named independent examiner and whole-liability scope are verified, subject to the documented currency gate if reconciliation continues to earn a graded 70 rung. A September 15 index page date is not the report period. No current reserve shortfall or measured non-reconciliation is alleged. Original August 15 review start and structured execution pins remain unchanged.
